terms.definition: A portable store of chemical energy that turns into electrical push.
terms.function: Supplies the push that drives current whenever a loop closes.
terms.whereItIs: The cutaway cell in the model.
terms.whyItMatters: It's how the world takes power on the move.

terms.definition: The two battery ends whose energy difference is the voltage.
terms.whyItMatters: Every battery contact and holder reads these marks.

terms.definition: Cells placed in series add their voltages to reach the pack rating.
terms.whyItMatters: It's how 9 V blocks and car packs reach their volts.
terms.whereItIs: The layered stack inside the case.

terms.definition: The slow spending of the chemical layers as the cell delivers current.
terms.whyItMatters: Capacity in mAh is the stamina number beside the volts.
terms.whereItIs: The layers shrinking under the usage dial.
